status: pilot-derived-from-existing-tests; requires owner approval before canonical promotion
notes: These are tested observed behaviors, not a claim of complete or formally accepted product intent. The pilot uses existing deterministic modules; it does not use paid APIs.

records.title: Preserve qualifications during revisions
records.statement: A rewrite that drops an explicit may/possible qualification must be flagged for human review; no assertion of semantic certainty.

records.title: Anchor claims in original text
records.statement: Every cited text span must point to exactly the original input characters, including offsets.

records.title: Distinguish contradictory quantities
records.statement: A pair of different comparable quantities about the same subject should create an explicit review signal without false positives for equivalent units.

mutation_catalog.behavior: Shift exact evidence spans one character
Change the quantity conflict contract identifier
Treat all matched anchors as preserved
